title: Ceviche de Camaron Shrimp Lime

seo.title: Shrimp Ceviche Recipe: Authentic Mexican Ceviche de Camaron
seo.metaDescription: Learn how to make the best authentic Mexican Shrimp Ceviche recipe at home! This refreshing Ceviche de Camaron with lime is easy, fresh, and bursting with flavor.
seo.h1: Authentic Mexican Shrimp Ceviche Recipe (Ceviche de Camaron)
h2Headings: Tips for the Best Ceviche de Camaron
seo.imageAlt: A vibrant bowl of authentic Mexican shrimp ceviche with avocado, cilantro, and lime wedges.
seo.imageCaption: Dive into this refreshing authentic Mexican Shrimp Ceviche, a perfect blend of fresh shrimp, zesty lime, and vibrant spices.

description: Ceviche de Camaron is a vibrant and refreshing Mexican seafood dish, featuring fresh shrimp marinated in zesty lime juice until perfectly 'cooked'. This traditional recipe combines succulent shrimp with crisp vegetables and aromatic herbs, creating an explosion of authentic flavors. It is a perfect light meal or appetizer, bringing a taste of the Mexican coast to your table.

ingredients.notes: finely minced, remove seeds for less heat

instructions.title: Prepare the Shrimp
instructions.text: Rinse shrimp under cold water and pat dry. Cut each shrimp into 1/2-inch pieces. Place the cut shrimp in a non-reactive bowl, such as glass or ceramic.

instructions.title: Marinate the Shrimp
instructions.text: Pour fresh lime juice over the shrimp, ensuring it is fully submerged. Stir gently to coat. Cover the bowl and refrigerate for 20-30 minutes, or until the shrimp turns opaque and pink, indicating it is 'cooked' by the acid. Stir occasionally to ensure even marination.

instructions.title: Prepare Vegetables
instructions.text: While the shrimp marinates, finely dice the red onion. Seed and dice the Roma tomatoes. Finely mince the serrano peppers. Chop the fresh cilantro. Prepare the avocado by dicing it, but do not add it yet to prevent browning.

instructions.title: Combine Ingredients
instructions.text: Once the shrimp is cooked, drain about half of the excess lime juice from the bowl. This prevents the ceviche from becoming too sour or watery. Add the diced red onion, tomatoes, serrano peppers, and cilantro to the shrimp. Gently mix all the ingredients together until well combined.

instructions.title: Season and Chill
instructions.text: Season the ceviche generously with salt and black pepper to taste. Stir well to distribute the seasoning. Cover and refrigerate for at least 15-20 minutes. This chilling period allows the flavors to meld beautifully and ensures the ceviche is served refreshingly cold.

instructions.title: Add Avocado and Serve
instructions.text: Just before serving, gently fold in the diced avocado. The avocado adds a creamy texture and rich flavor without getting mushy from sitting too long. Serve the authentic Mexican Shrimp Ceviche immediately with crispy tostadas or your favorite tortilla chips. Enjoy this vibrant taste of Mexico!

tips: Always use fresh, high-quality shrimp and ripe limes for the best flavor and texture in your ceviche. The freshness makes a significant difference.
If you prefer less heat, remove the seeds and veins from the serrano peppers, or substitute with jalapeño. For a milder flavor, you can omit the peppers entirely.
Serve your ceviche immediately after adding the avocado and chilling. It is best enjoyed fresh with crispy tostadas, tortilla chips, or as a fresh topping for tacos.
